jobs.description:
For our client in Beernem, we are looking for an experienced tiler.
 

You will join a young and dynamic team.
 

Be sure to apply if you are interested!
 

 
 

 

 
 

 
• You are a worker with several years of experience in tiling
 
• A driving licence is required!
 
• You speak fluent Dutch or English
 
• You have a VCA certificate or are willing to obtain one

Our client is the Belgian market leader in its sector, with a strong ambition to accelerate its international expansion.

While recognized as a leading player in its industry, the company has maintained the agility, entrepreneurial spirit, and close-knit culture of an SME. With a team of approximately 20 professionals, success relies on individuals who combine ownership, initiative, and a willingness to contribute beyond the boundaries of a traditional job description.

To support its continued growth and strengthen its internal organization, the company is looking for a Secretary General/Chief of Staff with a solid legal background and a strong operational mindset.

Jobomschrijving

Reporting directly to the CEO, the Secretary General acts as a trusted partner to the management team, ensuring that the company operates efficiently, compliantly, and in a structured manner.

The role is ideally suited for someone with a background as a lawyer, in-house counsel, or legal professional, who enjoys combining legal rigor with operational involvement. You will be expected to move seamlessly between strategic, cross-functional topics and day-to-day execution.

One hour you may be reviewing an important contractual matter, overseeing compliance obligations, or advising management on governance issues; the next, you may be coordinating an internal project, improving a process, organizing follow-up on key decisions, or liaising with external partners.

We are looking for an individual who combines a helicopter view with a hands-on mentality, who is equally comfortable thinking strategically and executing pragmatically.

Key Responsibilities

Governance, Legal & Compliance

• Ensure compliance with applicable regulations, internal policies, and corporate obligations.
• Support management in assessing legal and operational risks.
• Maintain a pragmatic and business-oriented approach to legal matters.

Operational Coordination & Business Support

• Organize internal meetings, monitor action plans, and drive accountability.
• Assist the CEO and management team with strategic and operational priorities.
• Facilitate communication and collaboration across teams and external stakeholders.

Process Improvement & Organizational Excellence

• Bring structure, clarity, and consistency to internal operations.
• Review and improve processes, workflows, and internal controls.
• Ensure that priorities are translated into tangible actions and results.

HR, Administration & Corporate Support

• Support HR administration, onboarding processes, and internal policies.
• Handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
• Contribute to a positive, efficient, and well-organized working environment.

Finance & Corporate Administration

• Oversee administrative aspects of invoicing, reporting, and operational follow-up.
• Coordinate with external accountants and financial advisors.
• Ensure that recurring administrative and financial processes are properly managed and monitored.

External Stakeholder Management

• Coordinate relationships with external accountants, IT providers, insurers, and other professional partners.
• Ensure that external support functions are properly managed and aligned with business needs.

Profile

We are looking for someone who:

• Holds a Master's degree in Law.
• Has approximately 5 years of professional experience, ideally as a lawyer, in-house counsel, legal advisor, or in a similar role combining legal and business responsibilities.
• Possesses a strong legal foundation and an interest in governance, compliance, and corporate organization.
• Combines analytical rigor with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset.
• Enjoys alternating between strategic thinking and operational execution.
• Is highly organized, detail-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality work.
• Is proactive and comfortable taking ownership without requiring constant supervision.
• Thrives in an SME environment where flexibility, initiative, and entrepreneurial spirit are essential.
• Understands that in a team of 20 people, everyone contributes beyond their title and is willing to step outside their comfort zone when needed.
• Is fluent in Dutch, and English. French is a plus.

Packaging Meat - 2-Shift - Oudenaarde  

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

We are looking for Meat Production Workers for a growing food company!

The company processes ham and packages it for various supermarket chains.

The job is not physically demanding!

Early shift: 5:00 a.m.–1:30 p.m.

Late shift: 1:30 p.m.–10:00 p.m.

You get a half-hour break.

PROFIEL

What are your responsibilities?

• As a packer, you will slice and package ham
• Work in cold/cool temperatures
• You will work in the Oudenaarde area
• You will speak in English, Polish or Ukrainian with your colleagues

AANBOD

What do we offer you?

• We offer competitive and fair compensation, and there is no mandatory collective leave.
• You can schedule your time off as you wish.
• A quick start is possible.
• You’ll work on a weekly contract basis, and after a successful temporary assignment, you’ll be offered a permanent contract.

Operator / Bender - Zwevegem

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

Do you have a passion for technology and are you looking for a challenging job with responsibility?
Become a bending machine operator in an innovative production environment! You'll bend pipes of various sizes, cut them to length where needed, and remove burrs. The work can be physically demanding, especially with larger pipes. Experience in the metal industry is a strong plus.

What are you tasks?

• 
Operate and set up the bending machine to ensure precise pipe shaping.

• 
Monitor the process and intervene in case of malfunctions to guarantee a perfect end product.

• 
2-shift system!

Dutch and/or English language skills are required.

PROFIEL

Your profile:

• 
You have technical knowledge or experience in a similar role.

• 
Accuracy and attention to detail are your strong suits.

• 
You are eager to learn and interested in automation and production processes.

• 
You can work independently, but also thrive in a team environment.

• 
Safety and quality are always your top priorities.

AANBOD

Our offer:

• 
A stable job in an innovative production environment.

• 
Competitive salary with extra benefits – salary + 12.50% shift bonus.

• 
Internal training and opportunities for growth.

• 
Work in a dynamic team with a positive and supportive atmosphere.

STUDIEVEREISTEN
Geen specifieke studievereisten
.

Welder - Semi-Automatic - Lokeren 

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

For a family-run metal workshop specializing in the production of steel doors and windows, we are looking for a semi-automatic welder to join the team. The company is known for its high-quality finishes, attention to detail, and passion for interior design and architecture. Every project is tailor-made — from design to the finished product — with a strong focus on craftsmanship and precision.

Job description:
As a semi-automatic welder, you will help produce steel doors and windows for both interior and exterior applications. You will be responsible for very fine welding work and ensure that every piece meets the highest quality standards.

Your tasks:

• 
Performing fine welding work (semi-automatic)

• 
Filing, grinding, and assembling components

• 
Cleaning and smoothing weld seams

• 
Reading and interpreting technical drawings

• 
Delivering precise, high-quality work

PROFIEL

Profile:

• 
You have experience as a welder or are a motivated school leaver

• 
You can read and understand technical plans

• 
You have a good knowledge of Dutch or English

• 
You enjoy detailed, varied work during day shifts

AANBOD
What’s on offer:
You will join a growing company with a strong reputation in the steel and interior design sector. You’ll work in a modern workshop alongside colleagues who value craftsmanship and quality.

STUDIEVEREISTEN
Geen specifieke studievereisten
.

jobs.description:
Deboning Department Employee | Fixed Morning Shift

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

Working in a cold environment is not an issue? Working in the pork meat sector is no problem?

The deboning department is looking for a motivated colleague with experience as a butcher, deboner or experience within the meat industry.

Dutch, English and Polish are spoken within the department. Candidates who master one of these three languages are eligible.

Fixed morning shift from 5:15 AM to 1:15 PM.

PROFIEL

• 
Experience as butcher, deboner or within the meat industry is a strong asset.

• 
Knowledge of at least one of the following languages: Dutch, English or Polish.

• 
Precise and efficient working approach.

• 
Physically capable of performing active and standing work.

• 
Availability for a fixed morning shift

AANBOD

• 
Quick start possible.

• 
Permanent option always available.

Geen specifieke studievereisten
.

All-round Technician | 2 Shifts | Oudenaarde

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

For a company in the meat industry Oudenaarde, we are looking for an All-round Technician.

What will your responsibilities be?

• You will be responsible for corrective, preventive and improvement-oriented maintenance of the machinery, equipment and buildings.
• You will carry out scheduled maintenance and perform the necessary repairs.
• You will ensure the production machinery operates optimal.

PROFIEL

Who are you?

• You are able to identify and resolve technical faults.
• You have a good command of either Dutch or English.

AANBOD

What do we offer?

• A challenging job.
• A dynamic working environment.
• Internal training opportunities.

Forklift drivers - 2 shifts - region Desselgem

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

Do you have experience as a forklift driver and a valid forklift certificate?

Are you willing to work in shifts and in a fast-paced production environment?

This internationally growing production company specializes in innovative solutions for the construction and interior sector and is known for its strong focus on quality and sustainability. They are currently looking for forklift drivers to join their team in Desselgem in a stable and modern working environment.

What will you do?

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Transporting goods within the warehouse
• Supplying materials to the production lines
• SCanning and checking incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse clean and organized

PROFIEL

• Forklift certificate
• Experience as a forklift driver
• Knowledge Dutch or English
• Willing to work in shifts

AANBOD

What do we offer?

• Attractive salary 
• Stable job in an international company
• Shift allowance (extra pay for shifts) 
• Modern and safe working environment 
• Opportunities for growth and long-term employment 

STUDIEVEREISTEN
Geen specifieke studievereisten
.

The company is a leading player in waste management, specialising in the sorting, processing and recycling of various waste streams. It continuously invests in new technologies to efficiently separate recyclable materials within a circular economy.
Multiple sites are located across Belgium.

Jobomschrijving

What will you do as a Hooklift Truck Driver?
	
• Transport, collect and place roll-off containers at customer locations	
• Secure containers with cover nets or tarps to ensure safe transport	
• Alternate between driving and manual work on-site	
• Respond to customer questions in a friendly and professional manner

What are we looking for in a Driver C/CE with Hooklift Experience?
	
• Driving licence C or CE; only C but motivated to drive with a trailer? CE can be obtained internally	
• Experience as a driver is an advantage but not required	
• You are an early starter (between 4 a.m. and 6 a.m.)	
• You speak Dutch, English or French for safety instructions

Forklift driver - polyvalent job

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

For a company in the Waregem area, I am looking for a polyvalent forklift driver.

Tasks:

• Operating gasoline-powered forklifts.
• Performing tasks without a forklift, such as hosing down trucks and containers.
• Working around live chickens.

PROFIEL

• You have a lot of experience with a forklift.
• You are in possession of a valid forklift certificate.
• You are flexible in hours. You start at 5am, but end times varies.
• You want to work in the area of chickens
• We can count on you 
• You can speak sufficient English. French is a plus.

AANBOD

• A fun job
• An attractive salary package

STUDIEVEREISTEN
Geen specifieke studievereisten

jobs.occupation: Customer Service Officer Polish - German - English
jobs.description:
As a Customer Service Representative, you will work Monday to Friday in rotating shifts between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM.

• Answer phone calls and emails from customers and partners.

• Collect and verify information.

• Provide technical support and maintain contact with repair workshops.

• Keep customers and all involved parties informed in a timely manner.

• Follow up on agreements and ensure all information is correctly processed in the customer file.

• You speak and write Polish, German, and English fluently to assist our customers effectively.

• You are comfortable working with computer systems and can multitask.

• You have strong communication skills and can handle phone calls and emails professionally.

• You are solution-oriented and always strive to provide the best support to customers.
